newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET SAYS TO INTERRUPT SAMARA CAR OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: VALMET SAYS TO INTERRUPT SAMARA CAR OUTPUT.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Valmet Oy said on Friday it would interrupt production of Euro-Samara cars for three weeks starting on April 28 owing to slower-than-expected sales.
"The aim is to adapt the car stocks," Valmet said in a statement, and added: "Sales have not developed as expected because some markets have opened slower than planned."

Valmet said the interruption of Euro-Samara car production would not affect other production at its Valmet Automotive unit, nor would it have any immediate economic impact as the company had taken "precautionary measures."

During the break in car production, the Uusikaupunki plant would undergo maintenance and some of the staff's annual holiday would used for this purpose, it said, adding that the arrangements applied to about 300 employees.
The plant has recently produced about 50 Euro-Samara cars a day, Valmet said.
